Subject: Private VPC networking follow-up / next steps

Hi Alex / Nadia,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment on the Private VPC deployment requirements you mentioned:  

- Deployment mode: you indicated a firm preference for Private VPC (no hosted API) due to sensitive payment data and regulatory concerns.
- Networking: primary ask is support for PrivateLink or VPC peering (your NetOps will prefer PrivateLink if possible). Need to confirm ingress/egress flows, management/control plane access, and IP allowlist ranges.
- CIDR: you mentioned current VPC is 10.10.0.0/16 (please confirm).
- Throughput & latency: expected steady-state TPS ~150 requests/min with burst to 600; target p99 latency <250ms for inference calls.
- Data residency & logs: logs/audit export requirements and retention discussed — you'll share compliance constraints.
- KMS/HSM: you asked about customer-managed keys for model artifacts/configs — we'll surface options.

Next steps I propose:  
1) Nadia to share VPC CIDR, preferred connectivity (PrivateLink vs peering), and any firewall constraints (NAT, egress proxies).
2) I'll loop in our infra engineers (Sean and Vivek) to do a technical review and propose a short Miro/Zoom session with NetOps to validate connectivity.
3) I'll send our networking checklist & stub for your NetOps to complete.

Attachments: private_vpc_networking_checklist.pdf (networking checklist)

If that sounds right, can we schedule a 45-min technical sync early next week? I'm available Mon/Tue mornings PST.

Thanks,

--

Thanks Marissa — great summary. A few quick answers from our side:  

- Confirmed CIDR: 10.10.0.0/16 (we'll confirm if there are any additional secondary ranges).
- Connectivity: NetOps prefers AWS PrivateLink for control-plane/management endpoints to avoid cross-account routing complexity, but peering may be acceptable for data-plane if necessary.
- IP allowlist: we'll need the list of outbound IPs your control plane and egress will use (management + telemetry). Also need any TLS cert requirements and whether mTLS is supported for ingestion endpoints.
- Throughput/latency: the traffic profile is accurate. We'll also want to size concurrent connections for bursts.

Nadia (cc) is our NetOps lead — Nadia, can you share current egress proxy rules and the team calendar windows for a technical sync? My calendar is open Tue/Wed afternoons PST.
